Post topic: How to Measure Influencer Marketing ROI
Alt text: Kudozz graphic titled 'Influencer ROI, counted properly'. Five steps: 1 Total cost (creator fees, product, production, usage rights, amplification, discounts, management time); 2 Attributed orders (net of returns and cancellations, deduplicated); 3 Revenue (net, after discounts, excluding GST or VAT); 4 Contribution (revenue minus product, delivery, payment and returns costs); 5 ROI. The formula reads ROI = (contribution minus total cost) divided by total cost, times 100.
